newsitem.title: CANADA: Allelix drops to 52-week low on block trade.
newsitem.headline: Allelix drops to 52-week low on block trade.

text.p: Allelix Biopharmaceuticals Inc dropped to a 52-week low after Nesbitt Burns commentary released today discussed the drug initiatives of competitors, the company said.
"It talks about competition to one of our products," said Allelix spokesman Jerry Ormiston.
Shares lost 1.00 to trade at 13.40 after dropping as low as 12.50 on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Deutsche Morgan Grenfell crossed a block of 732,200 shares at the 52-week low at midday.

Allelix's osteoporosis product, called PTH (Human Parathyroid Hormone), was under discussion, Ormiston said. The product, which is in the final week of advance clinical trials called Phase II trials, rebuilds bone eaten away by the disease osteoporosis.
Both Indiana-based Eli Lilly Co and Swiss-based Roche Holding Ltd are mentioned as competitors, Ormiston said.

Allelix said it will look at the Phase II results and ponder its next step with Swedish pharmaceutical firm Astra Ab. "Together with our partner Astra we'll decide whether to move into Phase III," Ormiston said.
